narrative.details: Ah, adventurer. I hope you continue to lend your experience to the different battlefronts. A lot of our lads and lasses in the field look up to seasoned veterans like you.
narrative.objectives: Bring 3 Alterac Valley Mark of Honor, 3 Arathi Basin Mark of Honor and 3 Warsong Gulch Mark of Honor to an Alliance Brigadier General outside the battlegrounds.
narrative.offerRewardText: You live up to yer reputation, adventurer. Without people like you, the Alliance wouldn't stand a chance against the savage forces of the Horde.
narrative.requestItemsText: Ah, adventurer. I hope you continue to lend your experience to the different battlefronts. A lot of our lads and lasses in the field look up to seasoned veterans like you.
